rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Residential kerb with homes 9-11 m from every part of it.
reasons: Cars park here, but houses overlook

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 11 m at the start and 9 m just beyond; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars already parked along the kerb; room to stop in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb; no-parking 7am-12 noon Mon-Fri signs.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the eastern half; open to sun elsewhere.

best_section.where: Hunter Street north kerb, western end by the ring
